source.head: feature/kyc-risk-tiers
source.title: KYC: risk tiers, manual review, async rescreen (multi-file)
source.intent: KYC: add risk tiers from sanctions score, birth country and nationality; send high-risk users to manual review (outbox kyc.manual_review_requested); make the nightly rescreen asynchronous via kyc.recheck_requested.

diff.text: async screen(person: { name: string; countryOfBirth: string; nationality: string }): Promise<ScreeningResult> {
let response: { hit: boolean; score?: number; listVersion: string };
// The list provider times out under load; one retry is cheaper than failing the whole KYC check.
return { hit: response.hit, score: response.score ?? (response.hit ? 1 : 0), listVersion: response.listVersion };
